articles.title: A Celestial Triple Header: Total Eclipse, Planet Parade, and Meteor Shower All on August 12
articles.summary: A total solar eclipse will sweep across Spain, Iceland, and Greenland on August 12, the first in mainland Spain in over a century. The same day features a six-planet alignment and the peak of the Perseid meteor shower.

articles.title: Pochettino Extends Contract: U.S. Men's Soccer Coach Commits Through 2030 World Cup
articles.summary: Mauricio Pochettino, the U.S. men's national soccer team coach, signed a new contract through the 2030 World Cup. His tenure saw a historic World Cup run with three wins and a record 50.1 million viewers for the Round of 16 match.

articles.title: Strait of Hormuz Standoff: Iran Denies Direct Talks with U.S. Despite Trump's Claims
articles.summary: Iran says it is negotiating with Oman, not the U.S., to allow commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. President Trump insists the U.S. controls the strait and that a deal is near, but Iran's denial has escalated tensions.
